fact: Umbaji built the Eyaa-Tom parallel text and audio dataset for ten Togolese languages and trained the YodiV3 translation, speech recognition and text-to-speech models, with portions hosted on Hugging Face.
title: YodiV3: NLP for Togolese Languages with Eyaa-Tom Dataset and the Lom Metric
publisher: Proceedings of the Sixth Workshop on African Natural Language Processing (AfricaNLP 2025), ACL
